text: …　…　まけちゃう　けどね

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃう is the casual short form of てしまう, which says the thing happens completely, often to your regret. まけちゃう = 'I end up losing'.

patterns.name: 〜けど
patterns.span: まけちゃう　けどね
patterns.explanation: けど at the end means 'though', taking back a little of what was just said. まけちゃう　けどね = 'I end up losing, though'.
